matches.rationale: Report finding 1 points to the same root cause in Mailbox.generateRandomNonce: the nonce is built from lastNonce and block values (blockhash, timestamp, coinbase), so future nonces can be predicted.
No report finding recommends replacing revert strings with custom errors.
No report finding raises the centralization risk of owner-only pause and unpause.
Report finding 4 describes the same defect in Treasury.emergencyWithdraw: the owner can drain the treasury with no limit or timelock, and it recommends a timelock or multisig.
